eps.ov: After going to sleep wearing a strange amulet, Mo Fan awakes in a world where everything is similar, except that magic exists. Mo Fan is determined to get into Magic High School so that he can protect his family. The trouble is that he has only known about magic for a few months, but everyone else has been studying it for years!
eps.oa: ينام «مو فان» وهو يلبس تميمة غريبة، فيفيق في عالم يشبه عالمه في كل شيء، إلا أن السحر فيه موجود. ويعزم مو فان على دخول ثانوية السحر ليحمي أسرته. والمشكلة أنه لم يعرف بالسحر إلا منذ أشهر قليلة، والجميع غيره يدرسونه منذ سنين!

eps.ov: Mo Fan awakens to his Magic Elements and begins to cultivate them. Discrimination against Mo Fan and his family continues.
eps.oa: يستيقظ «مو فان» على عناصره السحرية ويبدأ في تنميتها. ويستمر التمييز ضده وضد أسرته.

eps.ov: At the Magic High School exams, The Mu family tries to sabotage Mo Fan's practical score and get him expelled.
eps.oa: في امتحانات ثانوية السحر تحاول عائلة «مو» أن تفسد نتيجة «مو فان» العملية لتطرده.

eps.ov: Mo Fan does well in the Magic Exams and is put in the advanced class, where they are loaned training acceleration tools, however his amulet causes more trouble.
The advanced class goes on magic field training in the mountains. The training doesn't go to plan.
The advanced class panics as the training exercise goes seriously wrong. Only a few keep their heads.
MO Fan needs money, so he applies for a job on a monster hunting team.
The monster hunters confront a monster that has been terrorizing a girl's school.
A one eyed wolf has shown up in the city and is eating refugees. Is this one too much for the monster hunters?
The City hunters continue to battle the one-eyed wolf. They can hold it for now, but for how long?
Mo Fan attends the coming of age party for the Mu family ace, in preparation for their upcoming duel.

eps.t: Magic Duel! Mo Fan VS Yu Ang
eps.ov: The duel between Mo Fan and the young Mu Family ace, Yu Ang. Of course, you know the Mu family won't fight fair!
